theme.en: AI Chip Leadership Shifts as Investment Continues
theme.zh: AI芯片领导层更迭，产业投资继续推进

dek.en: Nvidia faces a CEO succession process as Samsung pledges 46 trillion won for an HBM hub and Cerebras gains a Microsoft deal. Growing congressional support for tighter China export controls adds another variable to AI-chip suppliers' plans.
dek.zh: 英伟达启动CEO接班人遴选之际，三星承诺投入46万亿韩元建设HBM基地，Cerebras则获得与微软的交易。美国国会对收紧芯片对华出口管制的支持上升，为AI芯片供应商的规划增添了变量。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO as Board Searches for Successor
title.zh: 黄仁勋辞任英伟达CEO，董事会寻找接班人

summary.en: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO, and the board is searching for a new leader, EE Times reports. The succession process becomes an immediate governance issue for a company whose accelerator roadmap anchors many customers' AI infrastructure plans.
summary.zh: 据EE Times报道，黄仁勋辞任英伟达CEO，董事会正在寻找新的公司负责人。英伟达的加速器路线图牵动众多客户的AI基础设施规划，接班人遴选因而成为公司当前的重要治理议题。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: TSMC Says Employee Data Was Posted Online from Cloud Provider's Systems
title.zh: 台积电称员工个人资料从云服务商系统外泄并被发布到网上

summary.en: TSMC says employee personal data was posted online from a cloud provider's systems, according to MLQ.ai. The incident puts third-party data handling and protection of employees' information under scrutiny at the foundry.
summary.zh: 据MLQ.ai报道，台积电表示，来自一家云服务商系统的员工个人资料被发布到网上。这起事件使台积电对第三方的数据管理及员工信息保护面临审视。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: Lee Jae-yong Pledges 46 Trillion Won to Turn Onyang into an HBM Hub
title.zh: 李在镕承诺投资46万亿韩元，将温阳园区打造为HBM基地

summary.en: Lee Jae-yong pledges 46 trillion won to transform Samsung's Onyang campus into an HBM hub, Korea IT Times reports. The commitment adds a large, site-specific investment plan to the competition to supply memory for AI accelerators.
summary.zh: 据Korea IT Times报道，李在镕承诺投入46万亿韩元，将三星温阳园区改造为HBM基地。这项面向具体园区的大规模投资计划，进一步加码了AI加速器配套存储的供应竞争。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: Taiwan DRAM Makers Plan EUV Adoption as Memory Demand Shifts Supply
title.zh: 存储需求改变供给格局，台湾DRAM厂商计划导入EUV

summary.en: Taiwanese DRAM makers plan to adopt EUV as the memory boom changes supply dynamics, Chosunbiz reports. The transition would make EUV tool access and process integration more important to their manufacturing roadmaps while extending demand for advanced lithography across the memory sector.
summary.zh: 据Chosunbiz报道，随着存储景气改变供给格局，台湾DRAM厂商计划导入EUV。这一转型将使EUV设备获取与工艺整合在其制造路线图中更加重要，也会扩大存储行业对先进光刻的需求。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: Speaker Johnson Says Congress Is Building Consensus on China Chip Export Limits
title.zh: 众议长约翰逊称国会正就限制芯片对华出口形成共识

summary.en: House Speaker Mike Johnson says Congress is developing consensus on limiting chip exports to China, 1470 & 100.3 WMBD reports. His remarks signal growing legislative support for restrictions, increasing uncertainty around future market access for chip suppliers and Chinese buyers.
summary.zh: 据1470 & 100.3 WMBD报道，美国众议院议长Mike Johnson表示，国会正就限制芯片对华出口形成共识。这番表态显示相关限制获得更多立法层面的支持，也使芯片供应商与中国买方未来的市场准入预期更加不确定。

title.en: Earnings & Markets
title.zh: 业绩与市场

title.en: Applied Materials Sales and Profit Rise on Semiconductor Demand
title.zh: 半导体需求推动应用材料销售额与利润增长

summary.en: Applied Materials reports higher sales and profit on semiconductor demand, according to The Wall Street Journal. Growth at the equipment supplier indicates that chipmakers' investment spending is continuing to translate into revenue for manufacturing-tool vendors.
summary.zh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，半导体需求推动应用材料销售额与利润增长。这家设备供应商的业绩增长表明，芯片制造商的投资支出仍在转化为制造设备厂商的收入。

title.en: GCT Semiconductor Pushes 5G Ramp to 1H27 as Shipments and Cash Decline
title.zh: GCT Semiconductor将5G放量推迟至2027年上半年，出货与现金同步下降

summary.en: GCT Semiconductor pushes its 5G ramp to the first half of 2027 as shipments fall and cash shrinks, according to Finviz. The schedule makes the timing of 5G volume shipments central to the company's near-term revenue and liquidity outlook.
summary.zh: 据Finviz报道，GCT Semiconductor将5G业务放量时间推迟至2027年上半年，同时面临出货下降与现金减少。5G批量出货的兑现时间，因而成为判断公司近期营收及流动性前景的重要因素。

title.en: Challengers & New Silicon
title.zh: 新势力与新硅

title.en: Cerebras Shares Rise 17% on AI-Chip Revenue and Microsoft Deal
title.zh: AI芯片营收增长与微软交易推动Cerebras股价上涨17%

summary.en: Cerebras shares rise 17% following surging AI-chip revenue and a Microsoft deal, SiliconANGLE reports. The named customer adds a concrete commercial milestone for an alternative AI-chip supplier as buyers evaluate accelerator options.
summary.zh: 据SiliconANGLE报道，AI芯片营收快速增长及与微软的交易推动Cerebras股价上涨17%。在买方评估不同加速器方案之际，微软这一具名客户为这家AI芯片新势力增添了明确的商业进展。

title.en: EnCharge Brings Analog Compute to M.2
title.zh: EnCharge将模拟计算引入M.2模块

summary.en: EnCharge is bringing analog compute to M.2, Jon Peddie reports. Using the common module format could ease host-system integration and make analog acceleration easier to evaluate in compact systems.
summary.zh: 据Jon Peddie报道，EnCharge正将模拟计算引入M.2模块。采用这一常见模块形态，有望简化主机系统集成，也方便紧凑型系统评估模拟加速方案。

theme.en: Hardware Efficiency Depends on Circuits and Dataflow
theme.zh: 电路与数据流共同决定硬件效率

dek.en: New device and EDA papers join earlier-November circuit and neuromorphic work from the merged feed. The selection examines reconfigurable logic, chiplet communication, parasitic-aware computation, and low-power quantum control.
dek.zh: 本期将新近的器件与EDA论文，同合并候选池中11月较早发表的电路及类脑计算研究一并选读。关注方向包括可重构逻辑、chiplet通信、考虑寄生效应的计算，以及低功耗量子控制。

title.en: Devices & Process
title.zh: 器件与工艺

title.en: Reconfigurable Neuromorphic Logic Circuits Driven by Ion-Mediated Organic Electrochemical Diodes
title.zh: 离子调控有机电化学二极管驱动的可重构类脑逻辑电路

papers.authors: Dongmi Heo, Min-Hu Huang, Youngseok Kim, et al.

summary.en: Organic electrochemical diodes implement multiple logic functions in a single diode-resistor configuration, with input-voltage polarity and frequency reprogramming channel conductance. Cascading two multistate circuits produces a proof-of-concept half-adder. The result connects device-level state control to reconfigurable logic, with the demonstrated scope centered on small circuits.
summary.zh: 有机电化学二极管通过输入电压的极性与频率调节沟道电导，在单个二极管—电阻结构中实现多种逻辑功能。研究将两个多状态逻辑电路级联，演示了概念验证性质的半加器。这一结果把器件状态调控与可重构逻辑连接起来，当前演示集中于小规模电路。

title.en: Circuits & Readout Systems
title.zh: 电路与读出系统

title.en: A Multi-Functional Streaming Readout ASIC With Channel-Embedded DSP and Neural Inference
title.zh: 通道内集成DSP与神经网络推理的多功能流式读出ASIC

papers.authors: S. Mandal, G. Deptuch, Jack Fried, et al.
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems Part 1: Regular Papers

summary.en: A 65 nm CMOS radiation-detector readout ASIC integrates 23 independent channels, each combining an analog front end, a 12-bit ADC, programmable DSP, and a fixed-point multilayer perceptron. The neural engine uses 8-bit weights and 12-bit activations for on-chip regression and classification. Supporting feature streaming alongside full waveforms moves data reduction into the acquisition chip and targets output-bandwidth demand.
summary.zh: 一款采用65 nm CMOS的辐射探测器读出ASIC集成23个独立通道，每通道包含模拟前端、12 bit ADC、可编程DSP及定点多层感知机。神经网络引擎使用8 bit权重和12 bit激活值，在片上执行回归与分类。芯片同时支持完整波形和特征流输出，将数据压缩处理前移到采集芯片，以降低输出带宽需求。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: SpikeLet Combines Hierarchical Interconnects with Spatial-Temporal Parallelism for Neuromorphic Chiplets
title.zh: SpikeLet结合分层互连与时空并行，扩展类脑chiplet系统

papers.authors: Jia-Jun Lu, Xiao-Yang Zeng, Chi-Xiao Chen, et al.
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Computer-Aided Design of Integrated Circuits and Systems

summary.en: SpikeLet combines hierarchical spike aggregation, cross-layer and cross-timestep parallelism, and communication-aware mapping for multichiplet spiking neural networks. On a 4-by-4-chiplet prototype, the authors report a 74.2% reduction in transmission latency in their evaluation. The design addresses the communication and scheduling costs that become important when a spiking network grows beyond one chip's capacity.
summary.zh: SpikeLet面向多chiplet脉冲神经网络，结合分层脉冲聚合、跨层与跨时间步并行，以及通信感知映射。在4×4个chiplet的原型上，作者报告其评估中的传输延迟降低74.2%。该设计针对脉冲网络规模超过单芯片容量后逐渐突出的通信与调度开销。

title.en: HyVox Splits Low-Power Speaker Identification Across Neuromorphic and von Neumann Processors
title.zh: HyVox在类脑与冯·诺依曼处理器间划分低功耗说话人识别任务

papers.authors: S. Addy, Eduardo Calle-Ortiz, Prashant Shenoy, et al.

summary.en: HyVox assigns speech embeddings to a neuromorphic processor and speaker matching, unknown-speaker rejection, and enrollment to a microcontroller. Its backbone compresses 6.5-fold to 29,000 synapses, while a 32-neuron embedding extractor passes only spike counts between the processors. This partition lets new speakers enter through gallery-prototype updates and concentrates sparse event-driven computation on the neuromorphic chip.
summary.zh: HyVox将语音嵌入计算交给类脑处理器，将说话人匹配、未知说话人拒识及注册交给微控制器。其骨干网络压缩6.5倍至29000个突触，32神经元嵌入提取器仅通过脉冲计数与另一处理器交换信息。这种划分允许通过更新说话人库中的原型注册新用户，并将稀疏事件驱动计算集中到类脑芯片上。

title.en: Hardware-Aware AI Research
title.zh: 硬件感知AI研究

title.en: An Educated Guess Derives Activation-Aligned Gradients for Zeroth-Order Optimization
title.zh: An Educated Guess利用激活几何构造零阶优化的梯度估计

papers.authors: Justus Huebotter, Serge Thill, M. van Gerven, et al.

summary.en: Spectral Zeroth-Order methods use activation geometry available during forward passes to derive gradient-search directions under explicit stochastic assumptions. The approach targets the poor alignment between random perturbations and true gradients in high-dimensional models. The preprint connects inference-only gradient estimation to learning on neuromorphic, asynchronous, and other hardware with demanding synchronization or differentiability constraints.
summary.zh: Spectral Zeroth-Order方法利用前向计算中可获取的激活几何，在明确的随机假设下推导梯度搜索方向。该方法针对高维模型中随机扰动与真实梯度对齐程度较差的问题。这篇预印本将仅依赖前向计算的梯度估计，与类脑、异步及其他在同步或可微性方面受限的硬件学习联系起来。

title.en: Quantum Hardware & Control
title.zh: 量子硬件与控制

title.en: A 16-Channel Cryo-CMOS Flux Control Pulse Generator ASIC
title.zh: 16通道低温CMOS磁通控制脉冲发生器ASIC

papers.authors: K. Tien, D. Frank, J. Bulzacchelli, et al.

summary.en: A 16-channel cryo-CMOS flux-control ASIC achieves a qubit-limited two-qubit gate error rate of 0.084% with a superconducting quantum processor while consuming less than 7 mW per flux-control channel. Three 10-bit sub-DACs operating at rates up to 1 GS/s combine to deliver 14-bit level resolution, with on-chip digital precompensation for off-chip distortion. The measured combination of gate fidelity and channel power provides a concrete integration point for scaling cryogenic qubit control.
summary.zh: 一款16通道低温CMOS磁通控制ASIC与超导量子处理器联合演示，实现了受量子比特本身限制的0.084%双量子比特门错误率，每个磁通控制通道功耗低于7 mW。3个以最高1 GS/s速率工作的10 bit子DAC组合出14 bit电平分辨率，并由片上数字预补偿修正片外失真。门保真度与通道功耗的联合实测，为扩展低温量子比特控制提供了具体的集成参考。

title.en: Electronic Design Automation
title.zh: 电子设计自动化

title.en: Agentic Design of Approximate DFT IP in TSMC 28 nm CMOS with RF-SoC Verification
title.zh: 基于智能体设计台积电28 nm近似DFT IP，并开展RF-SoC验证

papers.authors: M. S. de Silva, R. J. Cintra, A. Madanayake

summary.en: A Claude-based agent designs approximate-DFT digital IP around sparse butterfly factorizations, targeting TSMC 28 nm CMOS with RF-SoC verification. The approximate transforms are described as requiring O(N) multiplication operations, making arithmetic structure a central design constraint. The work provides a domain-specific case for examining AI-assisted HDL generation and hardware verification.
summary.zh: 研究使用基于Claude的智能体，围绕稀疏蝶形分解设计近似离散傅里叶变换数字IP，面向台积电28 nm CMOS并开展RF-SoC验证。这类近似变换所需的乘法运算量被描述为O(N)，因此算术结构成为设计中的核心约束。该工作为考察AI辅助HDL生成与硬件验证提供了一个专门领域的案例。

title.en: Signal-Integrity-Aware Training and Readout for Memristor Crossbar Arrays
title.zh: 面向忆阻器交叉阵列的信号完整性感知训练与读出

papers.authors: Han-Zhi Ma, Jia-Rui Qiu, Ye Shi, et al.
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Computer-Aided Design of Integrated Circuits and Systems

summary.en: A parasitic-aware training and inference scheme combines fast partial-element equivalent-circuit modeling with a readout rule based on quasi-steady-state arrival time. Matrix decomposition and sparse techniques accelerate array modeling, while dynamic unstructured pruning and parasitic correction address data-dependent signal distortion. The method links interconnect behavior to model deployment, targeting delay, crosstalk, and voltage-drop errors in memristor crossbars.
summary.zh: 一套考虑寄生效应的训练与推理方案，将快速部分元等效电路建模与基于准稳态到达时间的读出规则相结合。矩阵分解和稀疏技术用于加速阵列建模，动态非结构化剪枝与寄生效应校正则处理数据相关的信号失真。该方法将互连行为纳入模型部署，针对忆阻器交叉阵列中的延迟、串扰及压降误差。
